objective: Integrate accepted sidecar control-v2 shutdown with the accepted Windows mGBA supervisor so launcher exit quiesces authenticated checkpoint traffic, attempts one bounded Qt-friendly close of the exact owned emulator, reaps both owned roots, initiates whole-Job fallback deterministically, and reports any residual descendant uncertainty without releasing recovery state early.
closed_decisions: This unit starts only after root has consolidated the independently accepted sidecar control-v2 and Windows mGBA containment patches into its isolated integration worktree. The worker must integrate those APIs rather than reimplement or weaken either foundation.

Shutdown ordering is fixed: drain only an already-authorized checkpoint under its existing absolute bound; send one authenticated epoch-bound ShutdownRequest; require the matching Applied or exact Replayed CommandResult; only then attempt the emulator soft close. The ACK proves sidecar Quiescing, not save flush or process exit.

A mismatched command ID or epoch, Rejected, Conflict, malformed or oversized line, EOF before ACK, timeout, ledger saturation, or control failure skips the graceful claim and enters bounded force fallback.

The Windows soft-close helper is the guarded absolute System32 taskkill.exe path, launched without a shell and with exactly /PID plus the decimal PID of the retained mGBA process. /F, /T, /IM, PATH lookup, user-controlled values, and secrets are forbidden. The retained process handle remains owned across the PID operation.
taskkill success means only that a best-effort close request was accepted. It is never treated as flush or exit evidence; the retained child handle independently proves root exit.

One absolute shutdown deadline covers control ACK, helper completion, natural root waits, force initiation, and owned-root reaping. Unrelated events cannot extend it. Timeout starts force fallback immediately.

The pinned windows-spawn boundary atomically attaches the root to a private kill-on-close Job and can request whole-Job termination, but it does not expose active-process count or Job completion notifications. Therefore successful TerminateJobObject initiation plus root reap plus owned-handle closure is the strongest available result; it must not be described as proof that every descendant already exited.

A typed disposition records graceful versus forced flow, each owned root's reap result, whether whole-Job termination was successfully initiated, and whether cleanup or recovery retention is required. Any failed or unknown root reap, failed Job termination request, or failed cleanup retains the lease-recovery SAV and session directory for recovery. A successful request may close the Job handle after both roots are reaped, while documentation retains the residual descendant-completion limitation.

Repeated or cancellation-interrupted stop calls return the same cached terminal outcome and do not fail with BrokenPipe, resend shutdown, or repeat destructive cleanup. Early Ctrl-C before Lua connects uses the authenticated pre-bridge sidecar shutdown path and remains bounded.
Do not add a false test oracle. Tests may assert Job termination was requested and owned roots were reaped; they may not infer an empty Job solely from mGBA root exit or TerminateJobObject success.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit Cargo manifests or lockfiles, sidecar, cloud/server/protocol/save, bridge/Lua, ROM, manifest generator, regional identity data, documentation, or orchestration state outside owned_files.

Do not accept an uncorrelated ACK, soft-close before sidecar quiescence, equate helper success with emulator exit, use /F or /T as the graceful attempt, kill only the mGBA root as force fallback, or claim complete descendant exit without a real Job completion oracle.

Do not add unsafe Rust, allow attributes, a shell, PATH-resolved system helpers, secrets in argv/environment/logs/errors, unbounded reads/channels/tasks/threads/retries, or per-step deadlines that can exceed the one absolute bound.
Do not release or delete recovery material when root reap, Job termination initiation, sidecar reap, or cleanup has an uncertain or failed outcome.
Do not change checkpoint semantics, mGBA gameplay argv, regional progress/tier rules, authenticated fencing, or externally serialized save/control contracts.
Do not stage, commit, branch, fetch, pull, push, contact remotes, create/remove worktrees, or revert edits made by another worker.

acceptance_criteria.description: Launcher sends one authenticated control-v2 ShutdownRequest only after checkpoint drain and accepts only its matching Applied/Replayed result; every rejection, mismatch, parse error, EOF, and timeout takes force fallback.
A correlated ACK precedes one exact guarded taskkill.exe /PID request against the retained mGBA identity, with no shell, PATH lookup, force/tree/image flags, secrets, or PID-reuse window.

One absolute deadline covers ACK, helper, natural waits, force initiation, and owned-root reaping; unrelated events cannot starve it, and cancellation-safe idempotent retries return the same terminal outcome.

Shutdown returns a typed evidence-based disposition: it distinguishes graceful and forced paths, records mGBA and sidecar root reap plus Job-termination initiation, never overclaims descendant completion, and retains recovery state on uncertainty.

Tests cover matching/replayed and invalid ACKs, exact helper argv and helper races, early pre-Lua Ctrl-C, checkpoint ordering, natural and forced dual-root exit, Job-request success/failure, cancellation between supervisor exit and result delivery, idempotent stop, and recovery retention.
Launcher tests, Phase-2 smoke, strict launcher clippy, workspace formatting, local smoke, metadata, and diff checks pass with changes confined to owned_files.

return_when: Every acceptance criterion is resolved and every required verification command has a recorded outcome.
An accepted foundation does not expose the required correlated shutdown or root-reap seam and proceeding would cross owned_files.
A concrete Windows close, root-reap, or recovery-retention blocker prevents safe progress within the execution budget.
